summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Notion-like features: right-click context menu, three view modes (Table/Kanban/By Project), and hierarchical project structure. All 17 backend API tests passed. All 14 frontend features tested and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: OperationsPage.js is now 1539 lines - strongly recommend splitting into separate component files: ContextMenu, KanbanView, ByProjectView, NotionTable, CellEditor, TemplateModal
New Group button uses browser prompt() - consider replacing with a modal for better UX consistency
seed_data_creation: Test databases created and cleaned up during testing. Existing data: Website database with 'Dew Clinic' project
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features implemented and tested: 1) Right-click context menu on database tabs with 6 options (Add to Favorites, Copy link, Duplicate, Rename, Open in new tab, Move to Trash), 2) Three view modes (Table, Kanban, By Project) with toggle buttons, 3) Projects/groups within databases with collapse/expand, 4) Tasks can be added to specific projects. Backend APIs for /duplicate, /projects CRUD, and row project_id support all working.
